What Are Sweepstakes Casinos?

  • Sweeps Coins, on the other hand, are the exciting part. Play in Promotional Mode, and you can potentially redeem them for actual prizes, like cash or gift cards.
I appreciate that these casinos offer various ways to acquire these coins for free. From welcome bonuses to gameplay rewards, the opportunities are plentiful. Sweepstakes vs. Traditional Online Casinos

The fundamental difference between sweepstakes casinos and their traditional counterparts is the currency. In traditional online casinos, you wager and win in real USD. Meanwhile, sweepstakes casinos use Gold and Sweeps Coins, which don’t carry real-world value but can lead to real-world rewards. Traditional online casinos are legal only in select states such as New Jersey, Pennsylvania, and Michigan, among others. You need to be physically present in these states to participate actively. This limitation doesn’t apply to sweepstakes casinos.
